summary: Tested the new Rewards feature (user page /lobby/rewards + Admin 'Recompense' tab) end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_rewards.py with 22 pytest cases covering GET /api/rewards, product redemption (atomic deduction, plus_invite auto-voucher, unknown product, insufficient points), redeem-code (invalid/empty/inactive/reuse guard/universal max_uses/specific target guard/plus grant), admin voucher CRUD+toggle, claims list and status updates, and admin RBAC — 22/22 PASS. Frontend: found and fixed a CRITICAL crash (missing `Gift` import in Admin.jsx crashed the whole /admin page with 'ReferenceError: Gift is not defined'). After the fix all admin + user reward flows verified working in the browser.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL (fixed by me): <Gift/> icon used in the new Recompense TabsTrigger but not imported from lucide-react -> ReferenceError crashed the entire Admin page (blank screen, all admin tabs unusable). I added Gift to the lucide-react import line. Main agent should keep this fix.

issues: Generated PLUS gift code is only kept in component state (lastGiftCode); after a refresh/navigation the user can no longer retrieve the code anywhere in the UI (the 'Activitate recentă' rows never show claim.voucher_code even though the API returns it). Suggest rendering c.voucher_code in the activity row.
Minor: redeem-code input placeholder is truncated at desktop width ('Introdu codul tău (ex: ABC-1'), not blocking.

action_items: Keep the Admin.jsx Gift import fix (do not revert). Consider a lint/CI check for undefined identifiers — the whole admin panel was down.
Optional: show claim.voucher_code inside 'Activitate recentă' so PLUS invite codes remain retrievable after reload.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx used an unimported icon component — any undefined JSX identifier takes the whole route down; run `yarn lint`/eslint no-undef before shipping.

Backend rewards logic is solid: atomic $inc with {points: {$gte: cost}} guard, atomic used_count slot claim with max_uses guard, per-user voucher_redemptions uniqueness check, _id stripped from all responses.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after the Gift-import fix (0% before: admin page crashed)
